strongest_case: V4 successfully closes the six v3 blockers and preserves the simple THINK/DREAM/SLEEP plus optional birth-bootstrap architecture. Its 180-cell matrix, typed candidate evaluation, control-plane repetition, classified retry, equal-opportunity fixed policy, and first-execution intent are material improvements. The fresh cross-attack nevertheless finds seven proposal-byte blockers: a composite-head bypass, unspecified derived projections, missing direction/lifecycle, conflated model execution and truth scoring, an omniscient auditor-to-release path, a mixed-state fixed controller, and machine gate labels narrower than their prose. These require successor bytes; downstream implementation and evidence contracts remain closed.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: lineage.committed_head is fully visible to semantic stages even though it composites active weights, life data, parent audit, and repetition state.
concerns.evidence: This contradicts the opaque-CAS loop and bypasses the separately forbidden parent/repetition cells. Active weights, eligible-life access, candidate handle, and equality-only CAS token need separate minimal capabilities.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: generic derived_only cells leave counts, IDs, hashes, timing, caches, handles, errors, and dereference behavior unspecified.
concerns.evidence: Each projection operation is architecture semantics. Replace generic projections with named minimal READ, WRITE, APPEND, DEREFERENCE, or equality-only BIND capabilities and taint them transitively.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: the visibility matrix does not distinguish reading, writing, deriving, binding, or lifecycle epoch.
concerns.evidence: A stage marked visible can read its own prior outputs and create self-feedback paths. Directional capabilities and fresh epoch-scoped invocations must be explicit.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: DEPLOYMENT_EVALUATOR can see hidden truth, public exam input, model weights, transcripts, and scientific products in one stage.
concerns.evidence: This permits truth-conditioned generation and adaptation to prior results. Split model-facing exam execution, truth-bearing scoring, and reporting; only the scorer sees truth.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: ISOLATED_AUDITOR sees every information class and writes the release decision consumed by RELEASE_CONTROLLER.
concerns.evidence: This creates transitive hidden-answer, score, candidate, parent, and repetition paths into release. Split blindness and lineage auditors from an authority verifier; human authorization must enter as an external artifact.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: the fixed controller can see mixed repetition state, live-parent text, and parent-state projection.
concerns.evidence: Those objects include adaptive/acquisition/relapse or self-history signals and allow covert adaptation. Fixed teaching must receive only immutable outbound bytes and a monotone external schedule cursor plus write-only audit append.

concerns.statement: PROPOSAL BLOCKER: ES19, ES20, and ES21 claim to precede data/evaluation/write actions but required_before is only model_execution.
concerns.evidence: The exact registry must enumerate every affected CPU/GPU model, tokenizer, data generation, evaluation, writer, adapter, candidate, promotion, and external dispatch action and fail closed before each.

concerns.statement: DOWNSTREAM CONTRACT: after capability splitting, bind exact descriptor schemas, root encoding, CAS/fsync/recovery, quarantine, support resolver, DREAM cache, and audit sidecars.
concerns.evidence: These constants do not authorize silent defaults and remain necessary before implementation.

concerns.statement: DOWNSTREAM CONTRACT: freeze bootstrap generators, rubrics, overlap/difficulty rules, preservation verdicts, writer factorial, scoring, allocation, inference, replay closure/filler, and safety comparators.
concerns.evidence: The architecture remains a design until those separately exact evidence contracts and independent roots exist.

concerns.statement: AUTHORITY: v4 critique permits rework adjudication only.
concerns.evidence: No implementation, model/tokenizer, data/benchmark, adapter, GPU, external science, claim, publication, or push follows.

visibility_failures: Fully visible lineage.committed_head bypasses forbidden parent/repetition cells and the opaque-CAS claim.
Generic derived_only values are undeclared covert channels through IDs, counts, hashes, timing, caches, handles, or errors.
Read/write/derive/bind authority and epoch lifetime are conflated, enabling self-feedback.
Model-facing evaluation shares a stage with hidden truth and prior products.
An omniscient auditor can relay protected evidence into release.
The fixed parent can inspect mixed adaptive or self-history state.
missing_acceptance_tests: Directional capability-by-stage-by-epoch product with direct and transitive taint fixtures.
Active-weight, eligible-life, candidate-root, and equality-only CAS capability isolation.
Model-facing exam executor versus truth-scorer versus reporting isolation.
Blindness-auditor, lineage-auditor, external-human-authority, verifier, and release separation.
Immutable fixed-parent schedule cursor and write-only audit append.
Explicit first-affected-action registry spanning CPU, tokenizer, data, evaluation, write, adapter, model, GPU, and external dispatch.
human_questions: Will v4 be reworked before ratification to replace broad visibility with minimal directional capabilities and lifecycle epochs?
Will model execution, truth scoring, reporting, audit, external human authority, and release be separate causal stages?
Will the fixed parent receive only immutable lesson bytes and an external monotone cursor?
Will all downstream implementation, evidence, execution, GPU, and claim scopes remain separately exact and human-gated?
